incident-bot: ALERT: Multiple Route53 / health-check telemetry gaps detected for us-west-2. service: api-redwood-usw2. Severity: P2. Suspected flaky probes; customer-facing 5xx spike. https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0425
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: Paging Priya (oncall) — Escalation policy: regional-networking -> eng-oncall
Priya (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage: checking dashboards and probe logs. @Diego can you watch for any infra-level BGP / peering noise in us-west-2?
Sam (SRE): I see a jump in 504s from our edge LB stats around 02:12 UTC. Backend healthy checks show intermittent failures from several Route53 health-check IPs.
Diego (net): Checking peering and transit. No major BGP flaps in our telemetry, but our external probe endpoints are showing timeouts. Could be a probe-side issue or AWS health-check endpoint throttling. Opening a packet-capture request to the probe appliance.
Priya (oncall): Quick runbook steps: 1) verify probe telemetry + route53 health-check status 2) check LB target group healthy counts 3) enable fallback routing to other region if customer impact high. I'm running the first two now.
Maya (infra): LB target groups currently show ~92% healthy across targets, but unhealthy count spiked at 02:11. Rolling window shows health-check latency for the probe nodes increased.
Priya (oncall): Dashboard note: APM traces show requests timing out after waiting on external DNS/health-check resolution in some requests. Could be that our synthetic probes are failing to return expected responses, causing route53 to mark endpoints unhealthy transiently.
Lin (CS): We're getting customer reports of elevated errors for real-time features. Raising visibility to support ops; ETA to inform customers?
Priya (oncall): Short term mitigation candidate: increase LB health-check threshold and enable cross-region fallback for edge route (manual) to reduce client-facing 5xx. Will coordinate if impact grows.
Sam (SRE): Trying to re-run our synthetic probes from other regions to confirm if it's us-west-2-only. From us-east-1 probes succeed. From us-west-2 probes we get socket timeouts.
Diego (net): Packet capture from probe host shows SYN packets leaving but no ACKs returned for some probe destinations. I'll open a ticket with cloud provider on potential host-level filtering/throttling.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0425 created and linked. Priority: P2. Incident channel: #incidents. Owner: Priya.
Priya (oncall): Action log: 02:30 UTC — increased LB health-check success threshold from 2 -> 3 to reduce noise; monitoring to see if flapping decreases. 02:36 UTC — enabled temporary cross-region fallback for a subset of customer traffic to reduce error volume.
Sam (SRE): After the threshold change, detected 30% reduction in 5xx volume within next 10m. Good sign. Still seeing probe telemetry gaps.
Maya (infra): Re-deployed probe agent on two affected probe hosts (usw2-probe-1/2). Agents came back up, but telemetry still intermittent. Logs show repeated connection reset by peer on outbound sockets to health-check targets.
Diego (net): Cloud provider responded: "We've observed transient connection resets from our edge fabric in us-west-2 due to maintenance on a subset of peering nodes. We've mitigations in progress." Asked for timeline.
Priya (oncall): Customer impact: partial (some users) — realtime endpoints errors up, non-critical background jobs mostly unaffected. CS notified — Lin: please send a short note to affected customers: "We're seeing intermittent request failures in us-west-2; mitigation in progress; no data loss reported."
Lin (CS): Will send update. Draft: "We're investigating intermittent request failures in us-west-2 that may impact live features. Engineers have implemented mitigations; we'll update when resolved."
Sam (SRE): I'm going to collect a short post-mortem checklist while we continue. Key items: missing probe telemetry, route53 health-check flapping, cloud peering edge resets.
Priya (oncall): Handoff: I'm due for shift change in 30m. Sam, can you take over primary oncall for the incident? I'll brief you: mitigation applied (threshold bump + partial cross-region failover), provider is aware and working on fabric fixes, probe agents redeployed but telemetry still spotty. Follow-ups: verify probe fleet health, confirm provider ETA, prepare rollback plan if fallback causes downstream latency.
Sam (SRE): Taking over. Acknowledge handoff. I'll continue monitoring and will coordinate with Diego and Maya for provider ETA.
Priya (oncall): Handoff notes (final): 1) Incident INC-2026-0425 created. 2) Mitigations: LB threshold increased, partial cross-region fallback. 3) Provider reported edge maintenance causing connection resets. 4) CS notified. 5) Next: probe fleet audit + full traffic reroute if errors spike > 15% for 10m.
Sam (SRE): Thanks. I'll update the incident channel and set a follow-up ticket: INC-2026-0425-FU1 (probe telemetry audit). Also scheduling a post-incident sync with network and infra next week.
Diego (net): FYI I'll keep engaging provider NOC and share pcap if they request. Please ping me if you see new flaps.
Maya (infra): I'll run a health-check sweep across all probe hosts and post results to the incident doc.
Priya (oncall): Leaving now. If anything escalates, call my mobile. :phone: (reaction :thumbsup: from Sam)
